target.role: Fixed aesthetic/construction target, not registration or fit proof

rankedVisibleOutcomes.outcome: A compact rounded launcher with visibly constructed cradle, side mass and projecting barrel/muzzle. Firm softened edges and useful thickness replace the broad low rectangular slab and blank rail. The barrel remains the main functional shape in all four views.
rankedVisibleOutcomes.evidence: Target shows red rounded paired side housings, warm yellow-gold support/bands and a cool barrel with side hardware. Build a coherent narrower native interpretation inside the frozen reservation; literal target width and part counts are not requirements.
failureExamples: Broad flat source block with only changed color
Arbitrary greebles that erase the launcher silhouette
A narrow featureless stick justified only by the width reservation

rankedVisibleOutcomes.outcome: A warm red/gold support family and a clearly separate cool blue-gray mechanical barrel/muzzle. Large color masses and modest material changes keep construction legible at logical and phone scales.
rankedVisibleOutcomes.evidence: Target provides warm gold/red versus cool metal hierarchy, while the family concept supports warm crafted submarine equipment.
failureExamples: Uniform dull gray or red that merges every part
White blown metal or yellow highlights that flatten volume
Dark outlines or excessive black cavities standing in for construction

rankedVisibleOutcomes.outcome: Soft broad reflections describe curved forms and bevels without a preferred horizontal light direction. All facings retain readable surface gradients and joints; no dark dead side or heavy directional cast ground shadow.
rankedVisibleOutcomes.evidence: Inspect all four native views under one common symmetric standalone rig and under the exact frozen main context.
failureExamples: One facing substantially darker or flatter than its rotated counterpart
Narrow glare strips, clipped highlights or nearly black underside patches
Copied ImageGen halo or baked-in one-sided painted highlight

rankedVisibleOutcomes.outcome: A few meaningful bands, hinge/slide junctions, rim transitions, fasteners or shallow panels communicate an assembled mechanism. Detail follows the forms and survives downsampling as hierarchy rather than noise.
rankedVisibleOutcomes.limits: The editor chooses construction and part count. No demand that every target bolt survives at phone size.

rankedVisibleOutcomes.outcome: Static cradle stays grounded while barrel/muzzle retract together and recover over the actual 12-frame nonloop gesture. Motion is discernible in standalone playback at logical and phone scale, with no joint detachment, sleeve clipping or deformation.
rankedVisibleOutcomes.limits: Preserve the source native phase offsets and residual end pose. Do not invent firing, cable, projectile or a cyclic pulse. Mounted diagnostics audit clearance across every phase; later main adopts neutral idle only.

rankedVisibleOutcomes.outcome: At the frozen transform, a credible foot is visibly seated on the finite rear patch and a raised forward structure clears the hull/glass. The muzzle points toward local -Y and reads as a launcher beside the submarine focal parts.
rankedVisibleOutcomes.limits: The frozen body is technical context. Other upgrades remain clearly provisional. This component review does not approve the main body.

rankedVisibleOutcomes.outcome: No intersecting hull/base, z-fighting, exposed detached ends, cracked corners, abrupt broken normals, muddy merged forms, clipping at any canvas edge, temporal sparkle, alpha fringes, target-plane substitution or dead spots in N/E/S/W idle and active.
rankedVisibleOutcomes.evidence: Inspect actual native images enlarged and at intended scale over light/gray/dark backgrounds, full phase sheets and ordinary browser sampling.

designFreedom: Rebuild forms, proportions, construction, topology, native normals, UVs, materials and purposeful detail inside the reconciled technical contract.
Old broad base width, weak proportions and four source meshes are not locks.
Aesthetic similarity is judged by useful visible outcomes, not literal pixel or photographic identity.
